summary: Two inactive fragments give the fiber-maximum Lelong formula, ramification-weighted measure pullback, ordinary and ideal envelope identities below pulled-back obstacles, and the degree-scaled polar model embedding. Normalized pushforward followed by pullback gives a mass-preserving 1-Lipschitz retraction, compatible with ideal projection. The original-base model subspace is closed and complete; a cubic analytic example shows that averaging need not be nearest. All six proofs receive two complete final manual reads and 48 obligation checks. General P01/P17 and all 40 open assessment scopes remain unchanged.
